description: This header file declares the interface for a platform-specific filesystem monitor listener used within a filesystem monitoring subsystem. It defines initialization, cleanup, event loop execution, and shutdown functions, conditioned on the presence of a backend define.

methods.name: fsm_listen__ctor
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific data for the filesystem monitor listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__dtor
methods.description: Cleans up platform-specific data for the filesystem monitor listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__loop
methods.description: Runs the platform-specific filesystem event loop in the listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__stop_async
methods.description: Requests the listener thread to shut down gracefully.
